noticias.titulo: Previa Semana 11: Duelos decisivos en camino
claves: Jueves de NFL con choque estelar

en.contexto: We reach Week 11 with a schedule demanding immediate attention. Thursday starts the action with TNF, followed by a Sunday slate full of playoff-defining divisional matchups. It is time to adjust strategies and check injury reports before the initial kickoff.
en.fantasy: Week 11 is vital for playoff positioning. Monitor Sunday game times for last-minute changes. If you have players in early games, ensure you have bench alternatives ready in case of late injury reports.
en.equipo_impacto: Teams are adjusting tactical schemes for the final stretch. Players with defined roles will see increased workloads as rosters consolidate after 10 weeks of wear.
en.accion: Review your lineups against this week's schedule.

noticias.titulo: Alerta de lesiones: Mayfield y Bowers fuera

en.titulo: Injury Alert: Mayfield and Bowers out
claves: Brock Bowers out due to injury
Wandale Robinson to IR for 4 weeks
en.contexto: Week 11 hits fantasy rosters hard. Baker Mayfield will not play against the Lions, while tight end Brock Bowers is also out. Additionally, Wandale Robinson has been placed on IR for 4 weeks, complicating depth at skill positions.
en.fantasy: If you counted on Mayfield or Bowers, seek immediate waiver replacements. Robinson is a significant loss; do not keep him on your active roster if you lack IR spots. Look for options that ensure target volume this Sunday.
en.equipo_impacto: Absences force coaches to improvise with rotation players and rookies, which often alters offensive rhythm and pass distribution during the game.
en.accion: Remove Mayfield, Bowers, and Robinson from your starting lineup.

noticias.titulo: Waivers: Opciones de emergencia para la semana 11

claves: Mark Andrews and Brissett as options
en.contexto: With injuries mounting, the waiver wire offers alternatives. Michael Mayer and Mendoza are names to consider in deep leagues. Mark Andrews, alongside Brissett, seeks more prominence, while Strange profiles as an interesting option against the Giants this week.
en.fantasy: Prioritize players with higher target volume. If you need a TE, Andrews remains the name with higher pedigree. Strange could have a favorable matchup if the Giants' defense allows short passes over the middle.
en.equipo_impacto: These players must prove they can absorb the game volume left by injured starters to maintain their offenses' competitiveness.
en.accion: Add these players if you are struggling with roster depth.

noticias.titulo: Joe Milton se mantiene como mariscal titular de Eagles
claves: Joe Milton recibe la titularidad para la semana 11
Sean Mannion continuará como el responsable de la ofensiva
Nick Sirianni confirmó los movimientos de cara al partido
noticias.contexto: El entrenador en jefe Nick Sirianni confirmó que Joe Milton repetirá en los controles como mariscal de campo titular para el enfrentamiento de la semana 11 contra los Steelers. Además, Sean Mannion se mantendrá a cargo del diseño y llamado de jugadas ofensivas para este compromiso.
noticias.fantasy: La continuidad de Joe Milton bajo el centro genera dudas profundas en ligas de fantasy. Con Sean Mannion manejando la ofensiva y enfrentando a una defensiva dura como la de los Steelers, lo más prudente es mantenerlo en la banca en la mayoría de los formatos estándar.
noticias.equipo_impacto: Esta estructura ofensiva busca estabilidad ante la ausencia de piezas clave, obligando al resto de los receptores y corredores de Eagles a depender de la ejecución bajo un esquema conservador.
noticias.accion: Manda a la banca a Joe Milton y busca mejores opciones en el mercado de fichajes para tu alineación de la semana 11.

en.titulo: Joe Milton remains starting quarterback for Eagles
claves: Joe Milton gets the start for Week 11
Sean Mannion will continue calling offensive plays
Nick Sirianni confirmed the team decisions
en.contexto: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that quarterback Joe Milton will start again in Week 11 against the Steelers. Meanwhile, Sean Mannion will remain in his role as the offensive playcaller for the upcoming matchup.
en.fantasy: Joe Milton's continued presence under center raises major fantasy concerns. With Sean Mannion calling plays against a tough Steelers defense, fantasy managers should keep him on the bench across standard formats.
en.equipo_impacto: This offensive structure aims for stability in the absence of key players, forcing skill-position teammates to rely on execution within a conservative scheme.
en.accion: Bench Joe Milton and look for alternative streaming options on your waiver wire for Week 11.
en.en: Bench Joe Milton and look for alternative streaming options on your waiver wire for Week 11.

duelo.veredicto: Arranca a Joe Burrow. Con una proyección de 25.7 pts frente a los 21.8 pts de Prescott, Burrow se perfila como una opción más explosiva y consistente para tu alineación de semana 11.
